//: The comparison rig is compiled, not transpiled-on-the-fly: playwright's own
runner does not typecheck (which is why e2e/ has no other tsconfig), and the
rig is a standalone script rather than a spec. tsc gives it a real typecheck
AND the runnable output in one step.
CommonJS output is deliberate. e2e/package.json declares "type": "module",
so a .js file in this tree is ESM and node would demand explicit extensions
on every import — which e2e/helpers/*.ts (shared with the playwright specs)
does not use and must not be made to. run.sh drops a {"type":"commonjs"}
marker into dist/ so node reads the emitted files the way tsc wrote them.
//include: Only this directory. The shared helpers come in through the imports that
actually use them, which keeps the rig from taking on the typecheck debt of
helpers it never touches (the playwright runner typechecks nothing, so some
of them do not compile clean today).
